ATX closed heading style adds closing hashes

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"heading_style\":\"AtxClosed\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<h1>Closed Heading</h1>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
